general_information.name: IT’S SHANNON DELACROIX.
general_information.gender: Um, I think you mean how it should be listed on the form? I’m female, if that helps.

current_concerns.primary_problems: Mostly low mood and low energy over the last few months. I’ve also been worried that if things slip, I could relapse.
current_concerns.goals: I want to stay in recovery and, maybe, build a social life that isn’t centered on using.
